WITH ss_aggregates AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_1_to_20,
        AVG(CASE WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20 THEN ss_ext_tax ELSE NULL END) AS avg_ext_tax_1_to_20,
        AVG(CASE WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20 THEN ss_net_paid_inc_tax ELSE NULL END) AS avg_net_paid_inc_tax_1_to_20,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_21_to_40,
        AVG(CASE WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40 THEN ss_ext_tax ELSE NULL END) AS avg_ext_tax_21_to_40,
        AVG(CASE WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40 THEN ss_net_paid_inc_tax ELSE NULL END) AS avg_net_paid_inc_tax_21_to_40,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_41_to_60,
        AVG(CASE WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60 THEN ss_ext_tax ELSE NULL END) AS avg_ext_tax_41_to_60,
        AVG(CASE WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60 THEN ss_net_paid_inc_tax ELSE NULL END) AS avg_net_paid_inc_tax_41_to_60,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_61_to_80,
        AVG(CASE WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80 THEN ss_ext_tax ELSE NULL END) AS avg_ext_tax_61_to_80,
        AVG(CASE WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80 THEN ss_net_paid_inc_tax ELSE NULL END) AS avg_net_paid_inc_tax_61_to_80,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_81_to_100,
        AVG(CASE WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100 THEN ss_ext_tax ELSE NULL END) AS avg_ext_tax_81_to_100,
        AVG(CASE WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100 THEN ss_net_paid_inc_tax ELSE NULL END) AS avg_net_paid_inc_tax_81_to_100
    FROM store_sales
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN count_1_to_20 > 1071 THEN avg_ext_tax_1_to_20 ELSE avg_net_paid_inc_tax_1_to_20 END bucket1,
    CASE 
        WHEN count_21_to_40 > 39161 THEN avg_ext_tax_21_to_40 ELSE avg_net_paid_inc_tax_21_to_40 END bucket2,
    CASE 
        WHEN count_41_to_60 > 29434 THEN avg_ext_tax_41_to_60 ELSE avg_net_paid_inc_tax_41_to_60 END bucket3,
    CASE 
        WHEN count_61_to_80 > 6568 THEN avg_ext_tax_61_to_80 ELSE avg_net_paid_inc_tax_61_to_80 END bucket4,
    CASE 
        WHEN count_81_to_100 > 21216 THEN avg_ext_tax_81_to_100 ELSE avg_net_paid_inc_tax_81_to_100 END bucket5
FROM reason WHERE r_reason_sk = 1
